title: NetworkPolicy: only ingress can reach http/auth services
description: Keep services ClusterIP and allow inbound only from ingress controller (+ internal gRPC as needed)

title: Ingress auth_request headers + spoofing protection
description: auth_request to /jwtcheck, pass X-User-ID/X-Authorities/X-Jti, strip incoming spoofed headers; consider cookie->Authorization if snippets allowed

title: Auth: migrate to SPA (access in memory + refresh HttpOnly cookie)
description: Target: browser stores access token only in JS memory; refresh token stays in HttpOnly cookie with rotation + fingerprint binding. APIs accept Authorization: Bearer <access>. Refresh endpoint uses refresh cookie + fingerprint meta to mint new access and rotate refresh. Remove access cookie from the system.

title: Backend: issue access in response body; refresh only as HttpOnly cookie
description: Epic: Hybrid-kubernetes-non-local-52\n\nUpdate HTTPService auth endpoints to stop setting access cookie. Access JWT must be returned to client (JSON) and used via Authorization header. Refresh JWT stays in HttpOnly cookie and is rotated on refresh. Endpoints to touch: POST /verifylogin, POST /reactive/login, POST /exchangeTokens (or new /auth/refresh). Remove access cookie deletion paths; keep refresh cookie deletion on invalid session.
acceptance_criteria: - No Set-Cookie for 'access' anywhere\n- 'refresh' cookie still set/rotated as HttpOnly\n- Responses return access token (and redirectUri if needed)

title: Frontend: access in memory + axios Authorization + refresh-on-401
description: Epic: Hybrid-kubernetes-non-local-52\n\nImplement a single source of truth for access token in JS memory. Update axios wrapper to attach Authorization header to API requests. Add a refresh function that calls backend refresh endpoint using refresh cookie + fingerprint meta, updates access token, retries original request once.
acceptance_criteria: - access token stored only in JS memory (not cookie/localStorage)\n- all API calls send Authorization: Bearer <access>\n- on 401, client performs refresh+retry once; if refresh fails, redirect to /welcome

title: Backend: add /api/me + JSON chat APIs for SPA
description: Epic: Hybrid-kubernetes-non-local-52\n\nExpose minimal JSON endpoints for SPA bootstrapping: /api/me (user id, authorities) and chat data endpoints that existing thymeleaf pages currently render server-side (chat list, chat messages). These endpoints must require Authorization header (access token) and must not rely on access cookie.
acceptance_criteria: - /api/me returns authenticated identity\n- /api/chatlist returns chat list JSON\n- chat APIs are protected by Authorization header

title: UI: make chat pages SPA shells (no SSR dependency on auth)
description: Epic: Hybrid-kubernetes-non-local-52\n\nConvert /reactive/chatlist and /reactive/chat (and other protected pages) to load as public HTML shells and fetch data via /api/* using Authorization header. This avoids needing auth on full-page navigations (since browser can't add custom headers).
acceptance_criteria: - chatlist/chat pages load without ingress auth redirect\n- pages render data via API calls only\n- no user_id injected server-side

title: WebSocket: authenticate STOMP CONNECT with access token
description: Epic: Hybrid-kubernetes-non-local-52\n\nSockJS/WebSocket handshakes cannot reliably send custom Authorization HTTP headers. Move WS auth to app-level: send Authorization in STOMP CONNECT headers and validate on server with ChannelInterceptor. Enforce that messaging destinations require authenticated Principal; stop trusting user_id query params.
acceptance_criteria: - STOMP client sends Authorization header on CONNECT\n- server rejects CONNECT without valid access token\n- controllers use authenticated Principal/user instead of user_id query param

title: Ingress/Helm: public SPA shell + protected /api + no auth-signin redirects
description: Epic: Hybrid-kubernetes-non-local-52\n\nSplit ingress routes: SPA HTML + static assets must be public; JSON APIs (/api/*) protected with auth_request calling AuthService /jwtcheck using Authorization header. Remove auth-signin redirects for API paths (return 401 so SPA can refresh/handle). Ensure auth_request passes Authorization header to /jwtcheck.
acceptance_criteria: - /api/* returns 401 (no redirect) when unauthenticated\n- SPA shell loads without auth\n- auth_request validates access from Authorization header

title: Docs: update security flow to SPA access-in-memory
description: Epic: Hybrid-kubernetes-non-local-52\n\nUpdate docs/refresh-flow.md to describe the new flow: access in JS memory + Authorization header, refresh HttpOnly cookie, explicit refresh from SPA (no ingress auth-signin redirects), WS STOMP CONNECT auth.
acceptance_criteria: - docs match current implementation\n- includes 401/refresh/retry behavior

title: Add ingress route for /login/oauth2/code/google
description: Public ingress must route Google OAuth callback to authservice

title: Cache fingerprint/meta in localStorage
description: In meta_catcher.js: load cached fp data (with TTL), reuse if present; otherwise collect and save.

title: Ingress auth_request as sole auth gate
Docs: explain FP-driven refresh flow
description: Update docs to explain access/auth flow, FP collection, and refresh flow with missing refresh handling.

title: FP-first refresh flow
description: Make auth failure redirect to fingerprint refresh flow; cache fingerprint; update docs.

title: Backend trusts ingress headers (no JWT validation in app)
description: Use X-User-ID/X-Authorities from ingress for auth; avoid per-request JWT validation in app

title: Redirect auth failures to /collect-fingerprint
description: JWTCheck returns 401 on missing/invalid/expired access; nginx/ingress redirects auth_request failures to /collect-fingerprint?return_url=...
